title: Complaint Mentions and Biggest Mistake Remarks
summary: This topic clusters brief complaint-oriented fragments that mix general dissatisfaction with specific issues such as EV range in cold weather, wireless charging, and a parking button reference.

positive.summary: One positive review describes the G60 as the owner's best BMW and a notably improved update over the prior model.

negative.summary: Negative reviews express strong dislike, cite poor cold-weather EV range, and mention an issue described as a common complaint online.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly too short or incomplete to resolve sentiment, though they reference complaints about winter range, wireless charging, a parking button, and a 'biggest mistake' remark without enough context for consistent classification.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined, brief, or truncated, which limits confidence about the underlying issue and sentiment.
The topic mixes several unrelated subjects, including range, wireless charging, parking controls, and broad regret statements, so it is not a single coherent complaint theme.
One undetermined example is duplicated wireless charging text, and several examples contain only the word 'Complaint:' without usable detail.
